items.source: Model for a JMS listener endpoint. Can be used against a JmsListenerConfigurer to register endpoints programmatically.
items.translation: JMS 监听器端点的模型。可用于针对 JmsListenerConfigurer 以编程方式注册端点。

items.source: Return the id of this endpoint.

This endpoint must provide the requested missing option(s) of the specified container to make it usable. Usually, this is about setting the destination and the messageListener to use but an implementation may override any default setting that was already set.
items.translation: 此端点必须提供指定容器的所需缺失选项，使其可用。通常，这涉及设置要使用的 `destination`` 和 `messageListener``，但实现可以覆盖任何已设置的默认值。

items.source:
Set up the specified message listener container with the model
defined by this endpoint.
items.translation: 使用此端点定义的模型设置指定的消息监听器容器。
